Ivy Chen: Heads-up — a short processing lag impacted onboarding imports created 03:20-03:50 UTC. Need a concise external note + escalation plan for renewal-risk customers.
Marco Silva: Drafting now. Keep it two short paragraphs: what happened, ETA, manual workaround, assurance, and a goodwill gesture.
Becky Tran: Workaround: Console > Imports > Retry or API: POST /v1/imports/:id/retry. Logs indicate queueing/backlog, not data loss.
Anoop Verma: Infra update: fix deployed at 03:56 UTC, backlog drain accelerated. ETA to full catch-up ~2.5 hours.
Marco Silva: Draft outbound: `Hi — we detected a short processing lag affecting some onboarding imports created 03:20-03:50 UTC. Engineers deployed a fix and processing is catching up; we expect full completion within ~2.5 hours. To access newly ingested data immediately, trigger a manual retry in Console > Imports > Retry or call POST /v1/imports/:id/retry. No customer data was exposed or altered. As a courtesy we will apply a one-time ingestion offset to your account and invite affected teams to a priority onboarding huddle to review their setup. Reply "huddle" to opt in or book: https://redwood.com/schedule/huddle. For urgent help contact cs@redwood.com.`
Ivy Chen: Nice. Change "offset" -> "one-time ingestion offset (applied to your next invoice)" and add a micro-survey: "Was this update helpful? (Yes/No)" link: https://tiny.redwood.com/micro-feedback.
notify-bot: intercom-bot: campaign-created id=IC-20250721-04 by Marco Silva.

Marco Silva: Outbound sent via Intercom (IC-20250721-04). Please paste feedback tally and coached/huddle opt-ins here; well close after credits post and AM ack. Thanks team.
